sentences.ja: これは私の本です。
sentences.en: This is my book.

sentences.ja: あれは彼の車です。
sentences.en: That is his car.

sentences.ja: 彼女は私の姉です。
sentences.en: She is my sister.

sentences.ja: 私たちは友達です。
sentences.en: We are friends.

sentences.ja: これは難しい問題です。
sentences.en: This is a difficult question.

sentences.ja: 彼は医者ではありません。
sentences.en: He is not a doctor.

sentences.ja: あれはあなたのかばんですか。
sentences.en: Is that your bag?

sentences.ja: 私は今とても忙しいです。
sentences.en: I am very busy now.

sentences.ja: 彼らは教室にいます。
sentences.en: They are in the classroom.

sentences.ja: それはとても良い考えです。
sentences.en: That is a very good idea.

sentences.ja: 英語を話すのは楽しい。
sentences.en: It is fun to speak English.

sentences.ja: 彼に会うのは難しい。
sentences.en: It is hard to meet him.

sentences.ja: 毎日少し走ることは大切だ。
sentences.en: It is important to run a little every day.

sentences.ja: ここで泳ぐのは危険だ。
sentences.en: It is dangerous to swim here.

sentences.ja: 君がそう言うのは当然だ。
sentences.en: It is natural for you to say so.

sentences.ja: 朝早く起きるのは簡単ではない。
sentences.en: It is not easy to get up early.

sentences.ja: その本を読むのは面白い。
sentences.en: It is interesting to read that book.

sentences.ja: 真実を知ることは必要だ。
sentences.en: It is necessary to know the truth.

sentences.ja: 一人でそこへ行くのは無理だ。
sentences.en: It is impossible to go there alone.

sentences.ja: 彼女を手伝うなんて君は親切だ。
sentences.en: It is kind of you to help her.
